purpose: Versioned, applicant-isolated DAG for canonical career evidence, reusable domain resumes, job derivatives, platform-global/isolated resume slots and immutable application attachment lineage.

canonical_model.canonical_source: One approved canonical resume per owner graph snapshot, with stable source digest; source records may have independent richer provenance in career-state.
canonical_model.domain_master: Reusable domain-specific approved resume derived from canonical. Many domains and overlapping tags permitted, no closed enum of categories.
canonical_model.job_derivative: Optional opportunity-bound presentation derived from an approved domain or canonical resume. Never become a platform-global master by default.
canonical_model.platform_slot: Observed account/platform resume persistence context. A provider surface or site hostname is not proof of the slot scope.
canonical_model.application_snapshot: Application-to-resume edge binds the exact version used. Previously submitted applications cannot be silently rewritten.
canonical_model.per_owner_graph: No shared applicant graph, no cross-owner nodes or edges; do not import developer or collaborator context.

domain_weighting.input: Opportunity domainWeights tagged from reviewed job description. Never infer from platform URL, title alone or private other user's profile.
domain_weighting.categories: Open string tags (e.g., technology, management, construction, people_operations, healthcare_delivery); allow compound classification and future domains.
domain_weighting.matching: Candidate domain score = sum of opportunity domain weights whose tags belong to approved domain resume.
domain_weighting.ties: Equal top candidate score returns REVIEW_REQUIRED, not arbitrary lexical selection.
domain_weighting.no_match: Use canonical approved master if a domain has no evidence-grounded approved version.
domain_weighting.evidence_variance: Separately calculate V=1-sum(w_i*c_i)/sum(w_i) for complete job requirement coverage; V>=0.25 can request a new derivative, not change platform safety.

platform_persistence.approve_scope_only_after: Observed provider/browser persistence and exact account/session/opportunity binding, with operator-owned source authority.
platform_persistence.persistent_global: Only approved reusable domain master or canonical master may be proposed. A job derivative is NEVER selected for a persistent global slot.
platform_persistence.isolated_application: May propose an approved opportunity-matched derivative; upload still needs explicit candidate approval and exact document hash.
platform_persistence.server_claims: A private candidate document URL, file upload event, or ATS navigation does not prove platform persistence or employer acceptance.

operator_directed_switching.objective: EscapeHatch expands beyond any single job board's resume-management UX: the operator can freely switch between approved canonical and domain resumes and switch back at any time.
operator_directed_switching.selection_owner: The verified applicant selects an explicit approved resume and account slot; no role, domain scorer, application completion, queue scan, or agent preference forces a switch or rollback.
operator_directed_switching.default: Canonical master is the initial preference only when no valid prior user-selected resume is present; a valid approved current domain selection is equally reusable.
operator_directed_switching.one_action: One user-confirmed account-wide replacement action names the exact candidate digest and the observed effect of overwriting a shared slot; do not require a separate editorial review of already approved unchanged content.
operator_directed_switching.repeated_switches: Unlimited user-directed master-to-domain, domain-to-domain, and domain-to-master selections through the same planner, whenever the operator chooses.
operator_directed_switching.persistence: Store current operator selection in the existing private owner-bound graph; do not reset to master automatically after one job or an interrupted session.
operator_directed_switching.readback: Only observed ATS/provider account-slot content confirms a successful change. Until verified, show pending/unknown actual slot state without claiming a successful switch.
operator_directed_switching.no_queue_wide_lock: An uncertain/failed slot change cannot justify globally blocking unrelated applications; block only an unsafe mutation into that exact unverified slot, show the mismatch and allow other safe work.
operator_directed_switching.unknown_scope: Show private approved resume choices even if provider slot is unknown; disable only unsafe upload until slot ownership and persistence semantics are verified.
operator_directed_switching.redirected_forms: An Indeed-origin listing redirected to employer ATS uses that employer's observed slot rules, not Indeed-account-wide selection policy.

implementation.platform_adapter_integration: Must invoke resolver before a persistent or unknown-scope employer/platform resume mutation; currently pending live wiring.
implementation.proof_ceiling: Graph planning/validation and CI do not certify live Indeed persistence, attached PDF, account selection, browser action or application submission.
implementation.manual_switcher_api: resolveUserSelectedResume and listApprovedResumeChoices; actual per-provider browser call-site wiring and UI proof still separate

queue_effective_master.purpose: Score all selected, reviewed queued job domains to select one reusable account-wide master; prevent upload thrash from per-job matching.
queue_effective_master.input: Versioned list of explicit opportunity IDs scoped to the same applicant and one verified persistent_global platform slot.
queue_effective_master.aggregation: For each candidate approved domain master, sum the reviewed domain weights matched across the whole selected queue; select the unique maximum.
queue_effective_master.ambiguity: Equal maximum across domain masters returns REVIEW_REQUIRED.
queue_effective_master.output: KEEP_CURRENT if the exact effective resume already occupies the observed platform slot, otherwise UPLOAD_REQUIRES_CONSENT. Never mutate/upload.
queue_effective_master.indeed_operator_selection: Indeed may recommend canonical when there is no prior verified selection, but once a user chooses an approved canonical/domain resume, both per-job and queue scoring must preserve that exact selection; recommendations never override a user choice.
queue_effective_master.no_forced_rollback: No automatic restore after one job, abort, crash, or another application. Returning to master is a normal user-directed switch.
queue_effective_master.no_global_lock: Provider readback uncertainty blocks only unsafe writes to the affected slot, not the job queue or unrelated apps.
